items.title: Manuel "Fess" Manetta Interview, 1958-07-00
items.q: Mukes or something was his real name.

ctx.x: I was going to get my cornet. I was going to get my cornet. I was going to get my cornet. I was going to get my cornet. I was going to get my cornet. I was going to get my cornet. Neil Williams. He didn't play a short fella, black. He was a fella Jack. He had a big few on since you were in town. What is he like? He used to play a bass drum.
Oh yeah, I know. Mukes or something was his real name.
